name: 9Mesh
summary:
9Mesh is a number logic puzzle game for iPhone. Each puzzle is a small network of circles joined into equations that use addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. Some circles show a digit; the player fills the rest from a tray of the missing digits, using each digit from 1 to 9 at most once, so that every equation is true. Each puzzle has a single solution.

The main mode is laid out as a transit map: each zone is a map in a different shape, with Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert lines whose stations are puzzles. Solves are scored, with points lost for hints and wrong boards, and hints name an equation and explain why a digit belongs in it. A Daily puzzle, the same for every player, gets harder through the week, with scores and streaks on Game Center leaderboards. Flow mode offers a long run of puzzles at each difficulty, and visual themes are earned by playing.
